fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a disagreement over a payment settlement turned into a scuffle involving the complainant near Roja Park Main Street. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-10-19, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-18 at roughly 17:05. The complainant, Rajeshwari Ammal, provided the contact number 9000000242. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Kishore Arumugam, using the number 9000000189. A white car with registration TN-38-XX-1015 was observed near Roja Park Main Street. The complaint refers to Vignesh Balan, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000105. Amudha Kannan (9000000066) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement, photographs and physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00226, as the mobile number 9000000189 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
